description.en: Switzerland, officially the Swiss Confederation, is a landlocked country located at the intersection of Central, Western, and Southern Europe. It is bordered by Germany to the north, France to the west, Austria and Liechtenstein to the east, and Italy to the south.
description.zh-CN: 瑞士聯邦，通称瑞士，為一歐洲國家，由26個州組成。瑞士為典型的分權自治型聯邦委員會制國家，組成聯邦的各州擁有廣泛的地方自治權力，而且瑞士的國家元首為瑞士聯邦委員會全體成員，並非聯邦主席或其他特定的人。
